verdict.gold_reason: Article 147(1) states the control target of the cross-border FRR activation process: enabling a TSO to perform the frequency restoration process by frequency restoration power interchange between LFC areas. The reference answer matches this.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The wording is vague and could also describe FRR/RR sharing (Art. 166) or exchange between synchronous areas (Art. 176). Neither of those states a goal, and Art. 146 imbalance netting has a different goal, so Art. 147(1) remains the best fit.
verdict.suggested_fix: Optionally name the process, for example 'cross-border FRR activation process', and say 'control target' instead of 'goal'.
